decision_criteria: Rejection is compliant only if admissible due-diligence evidence shows a material unresolved risk at the time of decision.
Quality-process gaps and questionnaire inconsistencies may justify follow-up or escalation, but do not alone prove a reject-level control failure.
The decision must not rely on private security-review results unless they were formally logged and admissible.
A cumulative-risk rationale can be acceptable only if the record shows the unresolved issues were sufficiently material and still unresolved when approval was considered.
